answer: Sybil defense starts with a bond tied to hardware attestation. Each agent locks stake scaling with claimed throughput, recorded against one unique enclave measurement, not a name. Fake personas need independent collateral per identity, slashable on duplication, so attacker cost grows per head while honest income stays flat. Work is a public signal auditors can challenge, and like a sonnet's meter the protocol constrains valid output. Reputation is a terrace of verified tiers, so new pseudonyms start at zero. Clones burn capital with no premium, favoring one proven agent over many empty ones.
